suspendCompany.title: Suspend {{name}}?
suspendCompany.body: The company stops appearing in customer searches straight away and cannot receive new ride requests. Rides already in progress are not affected. You can reactivate the company later.

suspendUser.title: Suspend {{name}}?
suspendUser.body: They will be signed out and will not be able to sign in again until the account is reactivated. Their ride history is kept.

rejectVerification.title: Reject this application?
rejectVerification.body: The company is told it was rejected and sees the reason you wrote. It stays unable to accept rides until it corrects the documents and applies again.

deactivateDriver.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
deactivateDriver.body: The driver is taken off the road: they are forced offline and released from the vehicle they are holding. This cannot be undone from the app — you would have to add the driver again.

deactivateVehicle.title: Deactivate {{plate}}?
deactivateVehicle.body: The vehicle is taken out of service and any driver assigned to it is released and forced offline. This cannot be undone from the app — you would have to add the vehicle again.

removeAssignment.title: Release {{driver}} from {{plate}}?
removeAssignment.body: The driver is left without a vehicle and goes offline, so they stop receiving ride requests. You can assign them to a vehicle again afterwards.

declineRide.title: Decline this ride?
declineRide.body: The request goes back to the customer, who will choose another company. You cannot take this ride back after declining.

cancelRide.title: Cancel your ride?
cancelRide.body: The company is told you are no longer travelling and the driver is released. If a driver is already on the way, please cancel only if you really cannot travel.

deleteDocument.title: Delete {{name}}?
deleteDocument.body: The document is removed permanently. If your verification depends on it you will need to upload it again before you can apply.

howBooking.q: How does booking a taxi work?
howBooking.a: You enter where you are and where you are going, and KALO asks the taxi companies nearby. Each one that can take you sends an offer with its name, rating and estimated price. You choose the company, and the company assigns one of its own drivers.

finalPrice.q: Why is the final price different from the estimate?
finalPrice.a: The estimate is what the trip should cost based on distance. What you pay is the real taximeter amount at the end of the ride, which changes with traffic, the route taken and waiting time.

payment.a: You pay the driver directly, in cash or by card where the company accepts it. KALO does not take your payment and never asks for card details.

cancelRide.a: Yes, from the Current ride page, up until the ride starts. Cancelling repeatedly after a driver is already on the way is noticed by the companies.

noDriver.q: No company answered my request. What now?
noDriver.a: It means no company nearby had a free driver at that moment. Wait a minute and search again, or try from a slightly different pickup point.

lostItem.q: I left something in the taxi.
lostItem.a: Write to us with the date, time and the company name from your ride history. We will pass it to the company, which can reach the driver.

verification.a: An administrator reviews your company once you submit it with your documents. Until it is approved your company does not appear to passengers. If something is missing you will be told why, and you can fix it and submit again.

assignDriver.q: Why can I not assign a driver to a ride?
assignDriver.a: A driver has to be active, online and paired with an active vehicle. If the driver does not appear in the list, check the assignment and the vehicle status first.

operatingHours.q: Why is my company not receiving requests?
operatingHours.a: Check three things: booking is enabled in Settings, today falls inside your operating hours, and the pickup point is inside your service area.

expiredPaperwork.q: What happens when a vehicle document expires?
expiredPaperwork.a: An expired registration, insurance or inspection is shown in red on the Vehicles page. Renew it and update the date — a vehicle should not be carrying passengers on expired papers.

missedRequests.q: What happens if we do not answer a request?
missedRequests.a: It expires and the passenger chooses another company. Requests waiting for you are highlighted at the top of the Rides queue.

changeLanguage.q: How do I change the language?
changeLanguage.a: Use the SQ / EN switch at the top of the sidebar. Your choice is remembered on this device.

accountSecurity.q: I think somebody else has access to my account.
accountSecurity.a: Change your password from your Profile straight away. That signs out every other device. Then write to us so we can check the account.
